description: This file defines the class `PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator` which implements the `MenuConfigurator` interface to configure the left menu in the PIM module of the OrangeHRM system. It uses various traits to access services and helpers, and it implements a method to conditionally provide a menu item based on the user's employee number.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the left menu in the PIM module based on the authenticated user and current request context.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures and returns a specific menu item if the user's employee number matches the one in the request; otherwise, overrides the screen view and returns null.
